# My Roadmap: <start year> to <end year>

<!--
How to use this template
- Fill in what you know and delete what you don't need. Every section is optional.
- Dates can be exact (2026-12-31) or loose ("End of 2026", "Mid-2027", "Age 30").
  Loose dates are fine: you'll confirm them before anything is saved.
- Numbers can be ranges ("89–90"), limits ("under 94", "10,000+"), or changes
  ("down 4–5"). Money can be written as ₹1.4 lakh or ₹15 Cr.
- Write "to measure" for anything you don't know yet. The app will ask you for
  that first reading.
- Anything under "Notes" is kept for reference but not tracked.
-->

## Targets Over Time

The heart of the plan: one row per number you want to track.

-->

### Daily Habits (what moves the numbers)

<!--
The things you do each day or week that push the targets above, even
indirectly. This is where your day-to-day progress comes from: big numbers
move slowly, habits show up every day. "Moves" says which target the habit
helps. Leave it blank and the app will suggest a link.
-->

| Habit | Target | Moves |
|---|---|---|
| <Calories in range> | <2,100–2,400 kcal, 5 days a week> | <Weight> |
| <Protein> | <130 g+, 5 days a week> | <Weight, body fat> |
| <Strength workouts> | <3–4 per week> | <Weight, body fat> |
| <Walk or run 30 min> | <3+ days a week> | <Weight, running> |
| <Hours on company work> | <10+ per week> | <Company profit> |
| <Emergency fund transfer> | <once a month> | <Emergency fund> |

## Decision Rules

<!--
Things you'll only do when conditions are met. Write the conditions with
numbers where you can. The app checks the ones it can measure and asks you
to tick the rest.
-->

### <Quit the IT job>
All of these must be true:
1. <Company profit at least ₹3.5 lakh/month for 6 months in a row>
2. <Personal loan cleared, or the company is paying the EMI>
3. <6 months of personal expenses saved>
4. <Orders booked at least 6 months ahead>
